title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Sir, I am impressed with your research work about Islam. May GOD Bless you. Kindly answer my following question. Suupose I am owner of a educational institution. My cast is "A" (Suppose). I do not charge any fee from the students of my cast ("A"). Is this correct action in the light of a last Address of our beloved last Prophet (PBUH). Kindly guide so that I may correct my direction. Thanks! 1584 views Q. Please advise me after how many years should a child be put in a separate room to sleep and whether the age limit is different for boys and girls. jazakumAllahkhairun wa Rabbana-aatikuma--fahmal-nabiyeen-wa-hifzal-muqarrabeen take care fi amaan Allah 4399 views Q. Due to difference with my wife over staying in joint family, I have sent her to her mother's home so that she realize outside world and Allah may give her hidayah. I have two adult children; daughter 21 years and son 18 years 1790 views Q. مدرسہ میں امتحان کا نظام 4394 views Q. I am 19 year old currently living in karachi, Pakistan. I want to know whether it is feasible or not to attain Higher Education in London in islamic perspective? 10447 views Q. I've always wanted to pursue Islamic studies as well as medicals studies after graduation. However, as I'm nearing graduation, I cannot seem to choose a field as I would like to pursue both. What would you recommend I do? If I choose to do both, which would you recommend I do first, Islam or medicine? 2537 views Q. Assalaamu A'laikum. Hazrat is it permissible in Islam to do lectureship in universities in MBA(Finance)? I am dubious as in finance i will have to teach interest banking insurance etc. 1828 views Q. Is it permissible to perform circumcision (Khutna) using electro-cautery i.e cutting with electric-current instead of knife, to decrease bleeding, after giving local anesthesia? 2661 views Q. I am a university student doing B.S in biotechnology.A few days back my mind for continuing my studies sort of changed;i felt a strong urge of quitting my studies and going for an aalma course but the thing is that my mother(to whom i havn't told my recent plan)is very serious about my uni education and she even cried a bit about how much dreams she has associated with me.At this point i am really really confused as to what to do because i don't want to hurt her and i don't want to let my aalma dreams go to waste as well. Please do reply. 2000 views Q. MAHRAM 1954 views Q. I have two son's one name is AUSAF & onther is UZAIR, but Ausaf was very problematic boy he has no manner, he got angry and beat small brother and other small childern he did not listen to us if we tell him any thing he did not listen to do that thing now onwards is not so good in studies is mind always thinking other things just like in eating, other playing and dustrubing. we show to hime one maulana the maulan told us chage his name. he name is not sutible for him and for his mother & father, we are very much thinking about him and we too love very much to ausaf. his date of birth details are as follows:- Date is 19th of Khalik month, and day and time is satuday night at 2.10 am means (sunday morning) please help us we are very worried about him. or suggest a good name to him My name is syed irfan ali my wife is nausab irfan ali 2124 views Q. One of my muslim brother's sister-in-law has adopted a male child. The child is illegitimate. The Hindu mother gave birth to the child and left it in hospital. Through hospital child has been adopted and background of the child had been revealed by the hospital before the adoption took place. No one knows about child's father. My friend has a strong objection to this saying adopting illegitimate child is a great sin. Hence he avoid visting his father-in-law and mother-in-law who is staying with their daughter who adopted the child. He also restricts his wife from visting her parents. Kindly give the reply as per Islam ruling whether such adoption is permitted in Islam and whether my friend's reaction is correct according to Islam. Insha Allah also include us in your Dua. 2700 views Q. Is it permissible for a muslim school run by ulama to have in one class boys seated in front and girls at the back? 1860 views Q. كسی كا اپنے كو دوسری برادری كا ظاہر كرنا 1882 views Q. Asalamualaikum wa rahmatullahe wabaratuh 1- Over here in some Schools Religious education is compulsory for Muslims, so the teachers take the children to see Masjids,Church,Mandir,Temple etc my question is that is it permissible for the children to go inside the Church,Mandir,Temple etc? 2-Is there any sahih hadith which forbids Muslims from going inside a Church,Mandir etc to have a look? 3-Is it haram and a Sin to go inside a Church,Mandir etc to have a look? 2555 views
answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 56845 Country: India Title: میرا سوال یہ ہے کہ : (۱) شریعت کے مطابق اسکالر شپ (وظیفہ ) کے پیسے کو کیسے استعمال کیا جائے؟تفصیل سے بتائیں۔ (۲) کیا میں اس رقم سے پڑھائی کے مقصد سے لیپ ٹاپ خرید سکتاہوں؟ (۳) کیا میں اس کو اپنے ذاتی استعمال جیسے کپڑے/جوتے وغیرہ خریدنے میں خرچ کرسکتاہوں؟ Question: میرا سوال یہ ہے کہ : (۱) شریعت کے مطابق اسکالر شپ (وظیفہ ) کے پیسے کو کیسے استعمال کیا جائے؟تفصیل سے بتائیں۔ (۲) کیا میں اس رقم سے پڑھائی کے مقصد سے لیپ ٹاپ خرید سکتاہوں؟ (۳) کیا میں اس کو اپنے ذاتی استعمال جیسے کپڑے/جوتے وغیرہ خریدنے میں خرچ کرسکتاہوں؟ Answer ID: 56845 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! Fatwa ID: 127--93/Sn=3/1436-U حکومت کے قانون کی رو سے اگر آپ وظیفہ کے حق دار ہیں، اوراسے حاصل کرنے کے لیے آپ دھوکہ دہی یا غلط بیانی سے کام نہیں لیتے تو یہ وظیفہ حکومت کی طرف سے آپ کے حق میں عطیہ ہے، آپ اس کے مالک ہیں، اس سے آپ لیٹ ٹاپ بھی خریدسکتے ہیں، نیز اپنی ضرورت کی دیگر چیزیں مثلاً کپڑے جوتے وغیرہ بھی خرید سکتے ہیں۔ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
